name: Albescent-Rift
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by an ancient meteor crater. Beyond massive canyon systems, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Remnant spores persist in sheltered niches, a biosphere's last stubborn embers, awaiting conditions that may never return.
Around the exotic matter deposit, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
